In retrosynthesis (reverse), we need to break a C-C bond (i.e., bond broken) and form C-O bond, and generate ketone and alkyne functional groups. So functional_groups_formed (in forward) are ketone and alkyne? Actually forward loses them, so they are broken? The functional groups broken in forward are ketone and alkyne.
